comments.text: Suffering ultimately leads to salvation. We need all these challenges. This is how real growth is possible, it should not be comfortable. Pain is an unavoidable side effect of this life. Yet also a teacher, calling us to action. Do not give in. Do not give up. God bless you. God bless us all.

replies.text: Needed this. Pray against my lust

Never there was such a loss for gain, 
Till he died on the cross bearing our pain. Oh death where is thy sting ah but a borrowed breath returned to our King.

But not all suffering is necessary.

Not all suffering is good.

Just as others may give gifts and grace; they can spell suffering.

Neither’d been asked for, none was deserved.

One among infinite occurrences are the effects of your merits alone.

Failure amounts to the same level of value as the successes you gain from lessons learned by it.
If you never learn, you never succeed.

If you don’t succeed, you’re discouraged from finding a will for learning.

Discouragement after discouragement, your will erodes still.

Until you have none at all.

Life isn’t fair.

But imagining it a game rigged to lose is pointless if there was never a prize at the end.

The point of life is to live it.

Just as there is suffering, there are jubilations.

No, they will not be equal in distribution.

But they will present themselves.

We know not the future, so prepare for it via studying times past and acting in the present.

We can only hope.

I begged, pleaded, cried out for you to save me as you walked away, but my words fell on deaf ears. You abandoned me in my darkest hour, your cruelty a stark contrast to the person I thought I knew.  You offered friendship, a hollow consolation prize, but your words were as empty as the promises you broke.  You are a liar, a deceiver who crushed my soul beneath the weight of your indifference.  My love, my devotion, my unwavering loyalty, all weapons you used against me.  I valued you above all else, saw only you, and for that, I was betrayed, left broken and alone.
